items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Coleman Hawkins being on my recordings. I had formerly played with him on his.

ctx.x: Now, I also made some recordings with -- featuring Coleman Hawkins on Vanguard label, and on this particular session I had Earl Warren on alto saxophone, one of the old Count Basie men who was such a great first saxophone player, and along with Benny Morton on the trombone, who had also been with Count Basie and a great trombonist. And I had Joe Newman on trumpet, and I had -- let's see, O. C. Johnson on drums, and -- oh, I had -- I can't name all these musicians, but these were some of my most memorable…
Coleman Hawkins being on my recordings. I had formerly played with him on his.
